home.aboutLabel: Non un programma di allenamento. Un sistema di performance.
home.aboutP1: RESET90 è un sistema di performance strutturato progettato per ottimizzare i risultati sia a livello individuale che di squadra. Integrando profilazione metabolica, analisi neuromuscolare e cicli di intervento mirati, identifica le inefficienze che influenzano direttamente disponibilità, resilienza e continuità delle prestazioni.
home.aboutP2: Nel corso di un ciclo strutturato di 90 giorni, gli atleti vengono valutati, analizzati e ottimizzati sistematicamente nei fattori chiave della performance: produzione di energia, generazione di forza e resistenza sotto fatica.
home.aboutP3: Integrando profilazione metabolica, analisi neuromuscolare e cicli di intervento mirati, RESET90 identifica le inefficienze che influenzano direttamente disponibilità, recupero e continuità delle prestazioni. Ogni fase segue un processo chiaro: diagnosticare, correggere e misurare nuovamente.
home.aboutP4: Il risultato non è un miglioramento temporaneo. È una performance controllata e ripetibile in condizioni competitive.
home.whySubtitle: Il divario tra allenamento e performance è dove opera RESET90.

highlights.label: Il problema
highlights.title: La performance crolla sotto pressione.
highlights.description: La maggior parte degli atleti e delle squadre non fallisce per mancanza di impegno. Fallisce a causa di inefficienze nascoste. Cali di rendimento nel finale, infortuni ricorrenti e prestazioni incoerenti non sono casuali. Sono il risultato di lacune irrisolte nel modo in cui il corpo produce energia, genera forza e reagisce sotto fatica.

highlights.label: Il sistema
highlights.title: RESET90 sostituisce le supposizioni con una struttura.
highlights.description: RESET90 è costruito come un ciclo di performance di 90 giorni che collega diagnostica, intervento e rivalutazione in un unico sistema continuo. Integrando profilazione metabolica, analisi neuromuscolare e feedback sulle prestazioni, identifica esattamente dove la performance si interrompe e la corregge con precisione.

highlights.label: La differenza
highlights.title: Molti si allenano più duramente. Pochi si allenano in modo più intelligente.
highlights.description: L’allenamento tradizionale si concentra sul volume. RESET90 si concentra sull’efficienza. Invece di aggiungere più carico di lavoro, il sistema mira a ciò che limita realmente la performance: inefficienza energetica, squilibri di forza e calo legato alla fatica. Questo crea miglioramenti misurabili nella disponibilità, nella continuità delle prestazioni e nella resilienza.

highlights.label: Il risultato
highlights.title: Prestazioni su cui puoi contare.
highlights.description: RESET90 offre prestazioni misurabili e ripetibili sotto reali esigenze competitive. Gli atleti mantengono una produzione più elevata, recuperano più velocemente e preservano l’efficienza sotto fatica. Le squadre operano con maggiore disponibilità, meno infortuni non da contatto e una performance fisica costante durante tutta la stagione.

about.why90P2: Every RESET90 program is structured around this cycle: assess, plan, execute, measure, and evolve. Whether you're training online or with our professional team, the 90-day structure ensures accountability, progression, and results.

faq.label: FAQ
faq.stillDesc: Request an introduction meeting and we'll answer everything in person.

items.a: RESET90 is a precision transformation system built on structured 90-day cycles. Each program combines physical training, nutrition, and our Lifestyle Optimization System (stress, sleep, habits, mindset) to deliver measurable, sustainable results.

Each cycle follows a structured framework: assess, plan, execute, measure, and evolve. You start with a consultation, receive a tailored plan, and work through it with regular check-ins and adjustments. After 90 days, you can renew or step up to the next level.

items.q: What equipment do I need for online programs?
items.a: Most online bundles include a RESET90 Fitness Equipment Kit and walking pad. The Standard bundle includes a Resistance Band Kit. The Reduced Mobility bundle does not include a walking pad. All equipment is provided as part of your program.

Consultations are held via video call. Frequency depends on your bundle: bi-weekly for Standard, weekly for Advanced/Post-Pregnancy/Post-Operations/Reduced Mobility, and twice-weekly for Premium. Each session reviews progress and adjusts your plan.

items.q: What support is available between consultations?
items.a: All bundles include 24/7 email support. Advanced and above include WhatsApp and phone support during CET working hours. Premium members receive priority access across all channels.

Before committing to any program, you can request a free video introduction meeting with the RESET90 coaching team. It's a no-pressure conversation to understand your goals, explain the program, and ensure alignment.

items.q: Are prices displayed on the website?
items.a: Prices are not emphasized upfront. We prioritize clarity and value first. Pricing is presented during the introduction meeting or at the purchase stage, once you have a clear understanding of the program.

RESET90 Professional is our in-person coaching model. It serves athletes, team sports, and premium individuals through hands-on 90-day cycles with advanced testing (DEXA, metabolic) and face-to-face coaching.

items.q: Is RESET90 suitable for people with medical conditions?
items.a: Our Post-Operations and Reduced Mobility programs are designed for recovery and adaptation. However, RESET90 is not a medical program. Post-Operations requires medical clearance before beginning. Always consult your doctor first.
Yes, adjustments can be discussed during your consultations. We aim for flexibility within the 90-day structure to ensure the program remains aligned with your evolving needs.

policies.privacyIntro: At RESET90, we take your privacy seriously. This policy outlines how we collect, use, and protect your personal information.
policies.infoCollectDesc: We collect information you provide directly: name, email, phone number, goals, and health-related information shared during consultations. We also collect usage data through cookies and analytics.
policies.howWeUseDesc: Your information is used to deliver and personalize your program, communicate with you about your progress, and improve our services. We never sell your personal data to third parties.
policies.dataProtectionDesc: We implement appropriate security measures to protect your personal information. Health-related data is handled with extra care in compliance with applicable regulations.
policies.yourRightsDesc: You have the right to access, correct, or delete your personal data at any time. Contact us at privacy@reset90.be for any data-related requests.
policies.tosIntro: By using RESET90 services, you agree to the following terms and conditions.
policies.disclaimerDesc: RESET90 provides fitness coaching and lifestyle optimization services. We are not a medical provider. Clients with medical conditions must obtain clearance from their healthcare provider before starting any program.
policies.paymentsDesc: Programs run on 90-day cycles. Payment terms and refund policies are discussed during your introduction meeting and detailed in your individual agreement.
policies.ipDesc: All RESET90 training plans, materials, and content are proprietary. They may not be shared, reproduced, or distributed without written permission.
policies.liabilityDesc: RESET90 is not liable for injuries or health issues that may arise during training. Clients participate at their own risk and are responsible for following safe exercise practices.
